nom: Kopari Beauty Sun Veil Illuminating Elixir Face Sunscreen SPF 38

avis.texte: It feels good and looks so nice on the face. Sunscreen is a plus; I love it!
It has a slight tint, soft glow and spf. I have many compliments on my skin and It's because of this product. It goes on light.
I absolutely love the way this product works on my face!! It gives my face such an amazing glow. I get compliments all the time. ❤

I first brought those products because I wanted a sunscreen that didn't burn my eyes when I put it around them. I fell in love with this product. Would probably re-purchase even though it's on the pricey side. Melts so perfectly into my make up.
My face loves this product. Moisturizer and SPF together gives my face a supple glow. I love it

I have seen this product work well on other people, but not me. I must be too fair for this product as it didn't give me a glowing look it just made me look orange and shiny. Wouldn't recommend for fair people.

avis.titre: Wanted to love this but disappointed
avis.texte: I always have high hopes for any Kopari purchase. This was no different. But the moment I used this product I was struck with the reality of something I haven't experienced before with Kopari. This product does not move around with any easy on your face. It was dry; not anything you could rub into your skin, couldn't even rub it across a small area of my cheek. Unfortunately It's in the process of being returned.
Amazing, leaves skin glowing and smooth! Will be purchasing again!
It truly reflects an effortless feeling of smoothness! Loving the feeling and look.

I love lipstick spray sunscreen but this is the worst product for the face I have ever used. I keep my products even if they are not the best for back up or vacation, but this one I threw away immediately! Waste of money! It never blended or absorbed it pilled up and had giant flakes sitting on top of my skin that fell onto my eyelashes and shirt for an hour. Had to wash my face and start over!
I love the smell and shimmer of this product! It smells great also while providing skin care!
Too orange. It made me look like I was literally wearing glitter face paint. I'm going to return. Sad bc I love the spray sunscreen by them and really wanted to love this too.

avis.titre: Wore this every day of my coastal beach vacation
avis.texte: Perfect for my "no makeup" makeup looks. Or you can mix w foundation at night for Natural glow, blended seamlessly. Should have higher ratings! Buying my second bottle right now.
I received this and have used it twice, and each time it burns my eyes
I'm an Esthetician for almost 20 years and I'm obsessed! I love it all! Feels good look good I just can't say enough! I can't wait to tell all my clients, family and friends! Great Job yall!! ????
Absolutely fantastic! I don't want to buy any other sunscreen! I smell like a tropical vacation and shimmer like a bronze goddess, all while being protected from the sun! ??

I wanted to love this product but it's definitely not for more tan skin. I like the consistency but not the glitter. I think if they took some of the glitter out, and made more shade ranges or even maybe clear it would be better. It also has a white cast so i don't recommend.
This smells and goes on so easy. The glow and protection from the sun is wonderful.

This is my new favorite skin product. I got it for a tropical vacation and am continuing to use it back home for my daily glowy look. It's so lightweight and makes my skin look dewy and fresh. I have sensitive skin and have had no issues with this product. If you're on the fence, just buy it! It's SO good!
I haven't completely used this product yet, but I didn't realize it changes your skin tone.

I have tan skin and this looks really beautiful but it feels very thick to put on, more so than a normal spf. The sparkles are so intense that my fingers look stained and sparkly after applying so know you'll have to wash your hands after. I dont have dry skin but this enhanced a few dry areas that were already irritated from flu season and using tissues. I will continue to use this but I do wish it was diluted a little more

avis.titre: I'm literally buying a second one so it's with me always!
avis.texte: I'm trying so hard to be better about SPF. So when I saw the Kopari spray spf (texture is a huge factor for me, so spray is the way to go), this popped up as an option, and I went for it. Okay. this stuff is amazing. I use it as the last step in my skin care routine in the morning, and let me tell you, I feel so darn confident. Glowing without looking like I fell face first in a vat of glitter. It goes on smooth, it blends beautifully, and I personally feel if I go over my skin with maybe some light powder, I don't need much more for Spring/Summer. I bring the bottle with me like I'm carrying the One Ring, so I'm buying a second bottle to keep in my purse. This stuff is amazing, please never change it and don't stop making it!

I like others got influenced and I wanted to like it but the glitter in this product really accentuates any texture you have. It's very yellow and does not work well with makeup. It starts to pill and separate. Feels sticky and heavy on the skin. Wouldnt weatr it alone, its very yellow. Only con is the spf

I loved using this after I used my moisturizer. I used it all over my face, neck, ears, shoulders, chest, and arms. Love using it before my makeup, i feel like it really set my skin up nicely to apply my makeup next. New fav

I saw one of my favorite influencers in a campaign for this, so I wanted to support and try it out, and I'm so glad I did! This will be in my daily rotation and it gives a really nice subtle sheen underneath my makeup. It gives a nice luminescence.
I'm 67 and I love this. It goes on really smooth and gives me some sparkle when I don't wear make up. Will be buying again.
This fells and smells so good. I love the whole line. I use this on days I don't wear make up. Gives me a nice glow. I'm 67.

I love this product. It looks great alone without makeup and it gives my skin a beautiful glow. It smoothes out my face blurring texture. I do have to say that I am olive skin tone. It has a tad of color so it works perfect for me but I can see how fairer skin might have an issue with the golden color. Maybe Kopari will come out with more color range. Overall the formula is AMAZING. I have also used it under my makeup once. I had minimal pilling but maybe ill just lighten the serum wear underneath. Its great for summer days when you don't want to wear foundation. Love it!

I have combination skin and it dried our my skin. I wanted to love it but I can't. Its too heavy on the face and leaves a sticky feeling. I am not even sure if i can still return it. I was soooo determined to love it but can't. It definitely does give a nice glow and coverage but not worth how heavy it leaves my face feeling.

I wanted to love this product, but it's super glittery and yellowish on my slightly tan skin. It smells great though. I own multiple Kopari products, too, and this is one I would not recommend or buy again as a middle-aged woman.

An influencer that i loveeee, was using this product and thought to give it a try. Iwas skeptical at first and usually try to be very careful with the products i use due to me having pretty dry skin and my eczema and psoriasis get in the way were sometimes my skin gets irritated or can be super super sensitive. But when trying it, IT WAS AMAZING. It gives me theperfect glow im looking for its super nice and soft in my skin. Doesn't irritate it at all and is perfect under my makeup. Gives me a smooth surface and doesn't pill at all. I know every ones skin is different and ir could vary but for me it works and i would totally recommend it to anyone that has a similarskin situation as me.
I LOVE this product!! It is so glowy and layers perfectly under makeup - so excited for all of the new SPF items from Kopari!
I don't usually gravitate toward glowy SPFs, but this one has a beautiful finish! it works perfectly as a makeup base and is stunning on its own too!

I'm super disappointed in this product. One of my favorite influencers was on the campaign for it so I wanted to support by purchasing it but unfortunately this product pills like crazy and it's so awkward under my makeup. It's really hard to use a brush over this product because it slides right off your face. It's also extremely yellow so although yes, it adds some of a glow it definitely makes me look like I'm slightly jaundice. I am so sad about this, but I just genuinely wanted to love it, but I can't.
Love the glow it leaves on my skin. On busy days I use it after my moisturizer and I'm ready to go, it leaves my skin looking refreshed and illuminated.
I LOVEEEE when sunscreen has skincare in it this product is so amazing and lightweight! Never makes me breakout

Sun Veil keeps me glowing year round! I've used it under makeup during winter months to add a glow and It's of course amazing in the summer. Also love that it has SPF - you need spf daily (even on overcast days girlies!) ‚ú®

I love this Sun Veil Illuminating Elixir Face Sunscreen SPF 38. First of all, the bottle is beautiful and chic. Kopari makes the best sunscreens, and they all give me a radiant glow. This one here goes on beautifully. It blends smoothly, doesn't feel greasy or sticky, and gives a matte finish, but it does add a little glow with the light-diffusing finish. I love that it has Hyaluronic Acid that gives me hydration, Niacinamide that helps smooth the appearance of my skin, Panthenol that gives me a smooth, soft complexion, and Vitamin E that helps protect my skin from environmental stressors. I love that this sunscreen doesn't pill, or leave a white cast or streaks.

This is such a great glowy face sunscreen elixir. It's gorgeous in the bottle and on the skin. Great for under makeup or wearing alone. Leaves a natural glow on the skin and offers a good amount of sun protection all while smelling delightful and tropical.

avis.titre: Love it but tricky for pale girls!
avis.texte: The formula is amazing but the gold doesn't work well with my undertones. I bought to use alone but without a skin tint overtop it looks like I'm wearing fake tan. Thankfully for us cool toned girlies if you put a natural skin tint over It's PERFECT.
I've gotten so many compliments since I started using this. It gives such a beautiful glow and the fact that it also offers sun protection makes it unbeatable.
This product is absolute perfection in every way. From the texture to the shine to the sun sunscreen, I can't live without it.
I absolutely love this It's stunning on the skin I can't get enough!
Love this sunscreen for everyday wear. It's lightweight and has a great scent. Sleek bottle and easy to apply. Excited to keep trying this!

So I am huge on sunscreen. I usually use the ordinary sunscreen but I saw this on Yolanda Diaz TikTok so I had to try it!! Let me tell you when I say I am obsessed... I mean it. It does not have that spf smell to it. There is a glowy tint to it but no white cast. It does have a illuminating glow it gives you but you don't look overly shimmery. It makes your skin feel soft and hydrated. After I put my make up on and got ready for the day, I did notice my skin looked glowy and more hydrated. It blended well with my make up. Even with it dried down, it did not feel oily or peeled with make up. I cant wait to try the other products they have! Side note the ingredients are amazing!

avis.titre: The sunscreen that leaves you glowing!
avis.texte: I absolutely love this sunscreen. I apply it on my face everyday prior to starting my day. It doesn't feel sticky. You can apply it under your makeup for a smooth finish!

Absolutely obsessed with this product. I'm an SPF girl all day everyday. Finding this product, which provides the SPF coverage that I need, while also giving me a radiant, dewy so finish is chef's kiss. To say I love it is an understatement!
I love layering this under my makeup. It gives me a great glow. Cons are that i can't use too much and can't really re-apply throughout the day. It smells good!

I'm absolutely loving the Kopari Sun Veil Illuminating Face Sunscreen SPF face DROPS. It is still winter in Kentucky and these drops hydrates, brightens, and supports my skin barrier while providing UVA/UVB protection and a subtle, refreshing silky glow.

avis.titre: Must have for glowy skin that's also protected
avis.texte: I got this for an upcoming vacation, nothing more than I love than a golden glow to my skin while sitting on a beach. But I fell in love once I put it on and how good it looks. It's a must have! What else could you want?! Glowy skin that's also going to protect you from the sun!

avis.titre: Gorgeous Even Glow With SPF Protection
avis.texte: Love how this product has SPF, evens my skin tone, and give the most beautiful subtle glowy highlight on my cheekbones in the sunlight. Beautiful texture, sheer, absorbs well. SPF that feels like nourishing skin care, I'll never settle for another face sunscreen this is pretty luxurious.
It's still winter in Ohio, so I have not used get. The product arrived packaged well. The smell and texture are nice. I can't wait until spring!!
